lvr4.name: Kerman Engineering LV-R4
lvr4.description: A heavy-lift, reusable launch vehicle developed by Kerman Engineering. Featured in the Deliverance cinematic.

lve2.name: Kerman Engineering LV-E2
lve2.description: A medium-lift, expendable launch vehicle developed by Kerman Engineering. Featured in the Deliverance cinematic.

ssvc.name: Kerman Engineering SSV-C
ssvc.description: If you want your shit in space, for cheap, or want your crap somewhere REALLY fast, this is the way to go.

ssvh.name: Kerman Engineering SSV-H
ssvh.description: If you want your PEOPLE in space, for cheap, or want them somewhere REALLY fast, this is the way to go. LEGAL DISCLAIMER: Kerman Engineering holds no accountability for injured Kerbals as a result of extreme G-forces.

deliverance.name: Kerman Engineering SLV-H Deliverance
deliverance.description: Is your Valentina Kerman stuck on Duna? Well, worry no more! The Deliverance has plenty of room (and sorta fuel) for a rescue! Starting at only $79,999,999,999.99!

sav920.name: Kerman Engineering SAV-920
sav920.description: A small yet capable little airliner, powered by dual overclocked C7 J-20 Juno engines. Designed by Kerman Engineering in KSC, Kerbin.

rover_er.name: Kerman Engineering MLRV Mobile Laboratory and Refinery
rover_er.description: The MLRV is Jeb's favorite rover, not only because it's the only rover, but because it has rocket engines.

lc_01.name: Kerman Engineering LC-01
lc_01.description: Sending Kerbals to space has never been cheaper! The Kerman Engineering LC (low cost) 01 is an upper stage, sitting on a single SRB, easily thrusting them into the void.
